composition: central blank panel within bordered frame
description: Layered collage elements—target rings in black-and-white and multicolor, multiple aircraft silhouettes in overhead and side-view orientations, two gold compact discs, and pale yellow drip marks—surround a central white panel bearing a single line-drawn jet. Cardboard, tape strips, and fragmented printed ephemera form the borders.
title: Untitled (Plane on Empty Page)
